_about: Visitor-facing words for Ask the Tape that the back end sends: the built-in rules' answer templates and the notice shown when built-in rules answered instead of the model. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by backend/app/agent/providers/offline_provider.py with numbers from LoanIQ's tools. Which question a rule answers is set in backend/app/config/llm.toml [[offline.rule]]; chip labels come from content/desk-questions.json. All data is synthetic; all numbers come from the tape.

offline.desk_question: {label}: {loans} loans with {upb} of current UPB, at a WAC of {wac}. The loans are listed below, largest balance first.
offline.desk_question_empty: {label}: no loans on this tape answer this question.
offline.summary: The tape holds {loans} loans with {upb} of current UPB. WAC {wac}, WA FICO {fico}, WA LTV {ltv}. {delinquent} loans are delinquent (any MBA status other than Current).
offline.no_match: Built-in rules answer the desk questions (LTV over 125, New York, Puerto Rico, 90+ / FC / REO / BK, Modified, Forbearance) and a tape summary. Try asking about one of those.

notices.desk_question: Answered by built-in rules: desk questions skip the model.
notices.unavailable: Answered by built-in rules: the AI model is switched off on this server.
notices.daily_budget: Answered by built-in rules: today's AI budget for LoanIQ is used up. The model is back tomorrow (UTC).
notices.visitor_limit: Answered by built-in rules: you have reached today's number of AI questions. The model is back tomorrow (UTC).
notices.timeout: Answered by built-in rules: the AI model took too long.
notices.refusal: Answered by built-in rules: the AI model declined this question.
notices.round_limit: Answered by built-in rules: the AI model needed more steps than LoanIQ allows for one question.
notices.error: Answered by built-in rules: the AI model could not be reached.
